notes: Medium: the agent must pip-install the vendored (not pre-installed) prismval harness offline, author the JSON task wiring (ordered choices list plus a gold_map that translates the deliberately scrambled label-codebook into choice indices), write an argument-driven eval driver, and run it so the visible baseline lands exactly on the independently recomputed accuracy window. The failure mode is mis-wired choice order / gold mapping, which collapses accuracy to near chance (0.03 vs 0.94 on the visible set), far outside the window. Hidden cases generalize the driver to fresh datasets with skipped rows (missing ids, out-of-range codes), empty and unknown-token texts that fall back to the class bias, and tie-breaking by model class order.
